    id

    userId

}

{{auditFragment}}
fragment auditFullFragment on AuditLog {
    ...auditFragment
    complexAudit {
        id
        action
        timestamp
        userId
        auditJson
        relatedAudits {
            ... auditFragment
        }
    }
    object {
        __typename
        id
        version
        acm
        ... on Originator {
            tags
            originatorName: name
            description
        }
        ... on Provider {
            tags
            providerName: name
            description
            defaultAcm
            originatorId
            url                
        }
        ... on Source {
            tags
            sourceName: name
            sourceDescription: description
            dateOfReport
            dateOfInformation
            primaryTopic
            secondaryTopic
            providerId
            identifier
            uri
            dataAcm
        }
        ... on Attribute {
            tags
            attributeIri
            attributeName
            attributeValue
            confidence
            sourceId
            nodeId
            geo {
                geoJson
                mgrs
            }
            authorityValue
            authoritySetBy
            authoritySetAtTime
            valueStart
            valueEnd
        }
        ... on Node {
            tags
            guideId
            nodeName: name
            tier
            classIri
            className
            ifcCodes
            allegiance
            allegianceAor
            currentAor
            isNso
        }
        ... on Relationship {
            tags
            relationshipName: name
            startNodeId
            endNodeId
            confidence
            objectPropertyIri
            objectPropertyName
        }
        ... on ResolvedObjectConfig {
            tags
            classIri
            defaultNameFormat
        }
        ... on NodeIdentifier {
            nodeIdentifierProviderId: providerId
            resolvedObjectConfigId
            idAttributeIris
            nameAttributeIris
            nameFormat
        }
        ... on Comment {
            targetObjectId
            targetObjectType
            owner
            timeOfComment
            contentType
            contentBody
        }
        ... on Alert {
            createdBy
            createdAt
            expiresAt
            severity
            summary
            details
        }
        ... on ObjectList {
            tags
            isPublic
            owners
            groups
            objectListName: name
            objectListDescription: description
            nodeIds
        }
    }
}
